column2: Fortifying Manila Bay will allow us to project influence across the western Pacific and secure access to the East Indies and South China Sea.
The province of §YManila§! receives a level 2 §Ycoastal fort§! and a level 7 §Ynaval base§!, while the state of §YManila§! receives a level 8 §Yair base§!.
Fortify Okinawa
Fortifying Okinawa will enable operations against the Japanese home islands and establish a strong defensive perimeter in the Pacific.
§YOkinawa§! receives level 1 §Yanti-air§! and a level 5 §Yair base§!, while the province of §YNaha§! receives a level 2 §Ycoastal fort§!.
Fortify Iwo Jima
Fortifying Iwo Jima will enable operations against the Japanese home islands and establish a strong defensive perimeter in the Pacific.
Expand Caroline Islands Bases
Expanding bases in the Caroline Islands and Truk archipelago will support sustained naval and air campaigns in the central Pacific.
Expand Guadalcanal Bases
Expanding bases on Guadalcanal will improve our control of naval operations in the South Pacific and routes to and from Australia.
Expand Wake Island Bases
Expand Midway Island Bases
Expanding bases on Midway will secure the central Pacific and provide a key staging point for transoceanic operations.
Avenge the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk
The shameful Treaty of Brest-Litovsk has never been fully overturned. It is time to tear this disgraceful page from our history once and for all.
Establish a Marine Corps
Developing amphibious forces will greatly strengthen our offensive capabilities and allow operations in distant territories.

Establish an Airborne Corps
Expanding airborne forces will greatly increase our offensive flexibility and allow deeper strikes into enemy territory.
$airborne_corps_goal_name$ Goal Bonus
Establish a Mountaineer Corps
Expanding mountaineer forces will greatly improve our army's effectiveness in difficult and rugged terrain.
$mountaineer_corps_goal_name$ Goal Bonus
Expand the Submarine Fleet
A strong submarine fleet is needed to cut enemy supply routes.
$submarine_force_goal_name$ Goal Bonus
Escort Ocean Convoys
We need sufficient escort ships to protect our supply routes.
$convoy_escort_force_goal_name$ Goal Bonus
Maintain Air Superiority
Control of the air determines success on land and at sea. We need sufficient fighters to achieve air superiority.
$air_superiority_goal_name$ Goal Bonus
Control Mexican Oil
Securing Mexico's oil fields will provide fuel reserves for industrial and military needs.
Curacao's refineries process much of Venezuela's oil. Controlling them will give the faction a reliable source of petroleum products.
Control Venezuelan Oil
Venezuela's abundant hydrocarbon reserves could provide our faction with fuel for military operations.
Control Guyanese Bauxite
Control of Guyana's bauxite deposits will provide the faction with resources for producing the aluminium needed for aircraft construction.
Control Surinamese Bauxite Deposits
Control of Suriname's rich bauxite deposits will give our faction the raw material needed to expand its aircraft industry.
Control Lapland Metals
Lapland's deposits will provide the faction with a reliable source of iron and tungsten ores for arms production.
Control Baku Oil Fields
Capturing Baku's oil fields will provide access to extensive hydrocarbon reserves essential to military operations.
Control Iraqi Oil
Iraq's oil extraction capacity will play an important role in meeting our forces' fuel requirements.
Control Persian Oil
Control of Persian oil fields and refineries will provide a reliable source of fuel for our military objectives.
Control Chinese Metals
China's rich deposits of valuable metals can provide essential resources for the faction's military industry.
Control Malaya's Riches
Control of Malaya's tungsten and rubber reserves will greatly enrich the faction's resource base, supplying manufacturing and military logistics.
Control Indonesia's Riches
Indonesia is rich in rubber, oil and other minerals essential to our industrial base. These will help ensure the faction's resource security.
Control Newfoundland Bases
Establishing strongholds in Newfoundland will allow us to control North Atlantic convoys and dominate the region.
Control Bermuda
Bases in Bermuda will enable more effective patrols of the central Atlantic and secure supply routes between continents.
Control Bahamas Bases
Bases in the Bahamas will let us control Caribbean sea lanes and protect the Atlantic approaches to the Americas.
Control the Panama Canal
Control of the Panama Canal is essential for rapid fleet movements between the Atlantic and Pacific and for strategic flexibility.
Control Trinidad
Trinidad's key location makes it vital for controlling Caribbean oil supplies and provides a strategic foothold off South America's northern coast.
The Azores' strategic location permits control of the central Atlantic, closing the gap in submarine and anti-submarine coverage and ensuring continuous air cover for convoys.
Control Iceland
Bases in Iceland will let us control the Denmark Strait and retain the initiative along the North Atlantic transport corridor.
The Faroe Islands' strategic location enables control of northern sea routes and supports military operations in Britain, Scandinavia and the Arctic.
Control Narvik
A presence in Narvik will secure access to vital iron ore supplies and allow control of Arctic supply lines.
Control the Danish Straits
A garrison in the Kattegat will give us complete control of movement between the Baltic and North Seas.
Strategic bases along Brittany's coast will extend the range of our aircraft and submarines in the Atlantic while opening a route into Europe.
Control Gibraltar
The strategic base at Gibraltar will let us control shipping between the Mediterranean and Atlantic.
Control Malta
Control of Malta will enable disruption of enemy supply and provide a military presence throughout the central Mediterranean.
Control Crete
Control of Crete will open the way to eastern Mediterranean dominance and provide a convenient base for operations in the Aegean and North Africa.
Control Cyprus
Control of Cyprus will support operations in the eastern Mediterranean and facilitate flights to and from the Middle East.
Control the Bosporus
Capturing the Bosporus will let us control all maritime movement between the Black Sea and Mediterranean.
Control the Dardanelles
Holding the Dardanelles will allow us to control warships and merchant vessels leaving the Black Sea.
Holding the Suez Canal will give us complete control of the main shipping route between Europe and Asia, enabling rapid transfers of troops and resources.
Strategic bases along the Gulf of Aden will defend the approaches to the Red Sea and control trade routes between Europe, Africa and Asia.
Strategic bases at the Strait of Hormuz will control access to vital Persian and Iraqi oil.
Control Ceylon
Capturing Ceylon will enable Indian Ocean dominance and protect key sea routes between the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
Control Singapore
The powerful fortified naval base at Singapore dominates the Strait of Malacca and regulates movement between the Indian and Pacific Oceans. It must be ours.
Control Manila
Fortified Manila Bay will project influence across the western Pacific and secure access to the East Indies and South China Sea.
Control Okinawa
Control of Okinawa will enable operations against the Japanese home islands and establish a strong defensive perimeter in the Pacific.
Control Iwo Jima
Capturing Iwo Jima will support long-range air operations over Japan and extend our influence in the central Pacific.
Dominance over the Caroline Islands and Truk archipelago will support sustained naval and air campaigns in the central Pacific.
